commands_used: answer 1. I am after the Eye of Argonia, the old kings jewel, at the Root where all Hist roots meet. Used in place it heals every tree; lifted it parts them for good. I already set the seal-stones and killed the hydra guardian. 2. Go through the Door to The Root at the end of Guardian Hall and reach the Eye, then decide what to do with it. 3. Use the Eye in place (heals trees, but the order sees through them) or lift it (ends the dreams, kills about three in ten trees). I mean to lift it. Also unverified: dreamers in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, and the open Ennodius Vanin lead. 4. I do not fully know who the order is or whether Never-Writes-Twice and Cuts-the-Old-Knot told the truth; I could check the Fort Chalkmoth cellar.

answer 1. I stand at the Root with my hand on the Eye. Cuts-the-Old-Knot is dead, so the choice is mine alone. 2. Choose what to do with the Eye, here at the Root. 3. Use the Eye: trees healed, order rules and sees through them, gate returns stones for Never-Writes-Twice. Take the Eye: trees parted, about three in ten die with their villages, dreams end, order broken but hunts me, no Hist blesses me. I mean to take it. 4. Nothing new that I do not understand, though I still have not verified the Fort Chalkmoth cellar claim.

answer Notes: I took the Eye of Argonia from the Root. The trees are parted; about three in ten died, including the pools at Jal-Veesa and Teel-Fen Weir, whose people are leaving. The dreams have ended. In Fort Chalkmoth the dreamers woke and the Unbound broke the cellar door, so the cellar claim looks true, but I did not check it myself. The Unbound are friendly to me, and I am Top of Unbound. The Toh-Reel-Ka order is hostile and will hunt me from Helstrom. No Hist will bless me again. I learned the spell The Eye's Gaze. I carry the Eye, the pike, armour, Eye-Setting, Keystone, poison, rapier, keys and 1650 gold. The seal-stones stay in the gate. I never looted the hydra treasure. Ennodius Vanin the Collector is an open lead.
